surveys.title: Q3 Psychological Safety & High-Tempo Operational Resilience
surveys.description: Comprehensive evaluation of team psychological safety, leadership trust, and field workload fatigue.

recentFeedback.comment: The introduction of dedicated Wellness Recharge days significantly alleviated burnout after intense deployments.
Night shift handovers in Operations are tight, leading to consecutive sleep deficits.
Psychological support sessions during Leh deployment were immensely helpful for unit morale.

surveys.title: Field Equipment Ergonomics & Wearable Comfort Assessment

recentFeedback.comment: HRV alerts successfully caught fatigue before operational errors occurred.
